_note: Citizen visits. Triggers are in src/sim/visits.ts, keyed by id; everything else is here. Placeholders: {name}, {home}, {floor}.

visits.title: Noise complaint
visits.text: {name} is here about the {home} on floor {floor}. "Nobody in our block has slept properly in days. Something has to give."

ignored.message: {name} gave up waiting. The {home} is grumbling about the noise.

choices.label: I'll fix it within 3 days
choices.hint: Move the noise away or buffer it with a corridor.

kept.message: {name} thanks you: the {home} is sleeping again.

broken.message: {name} says you broke your promise about the noise.

choices.label: Enact quiet hours
choices.hint: Ordinance: noise felt at home halved; noisy rooms 5% slower.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.hint: "That noise is the sound of air."

visits.title: Room demand: a clinic
visits.text: {name} speaks for the colonists: "Someone is going to get hurt down here, and there's nowhere to go. We need a clinic."

ignored.message: {name} left the office without an answer. People are asking why.

choices.label: You'll have one within 5 days
choices.hint: Build a clinic (needs brick, metal and electronics).

kept.message: The clinic is open. {name} is telling everyone you kept your word.

broken.message: Still no clinic. {name} is telling everyone you broke your word.

choices.label: Not yet: there are bigger priorities
choices.hint: Loyalty and happiness drop a little.
